about.json.seo_description: We are an international growth and storytelling partner for food, ingredient and purpose-led brands. We help businesses analyse and interpret new markets, build the right connections, and grow across Europe with clarity and direction.
about.json.title: Driven by vision and experience.
about.json.lead: We are an international growth and storytelling partner for food, ingredient and purpose-led brands. We help businesses analyse and interpret new markets, build the right connections, and grow across Europe with clarity and direction.
about.json.approach_title: Your product is only the *starting point*. Growth comes from understanding the world around it.
approach_text: With 25+ years across international marketing, branding and business development, and 10+ years covering the global food and ingredients ecosystem as a B2B journalist, we understand both the market and the people behind it. We combine sector insight, commercial thinking and an international network, bringing in trusted European specialists when deeper expertise is needed. This approach has shaped projects with companies across ingredients, food, foodservice, fresh produce, sustainability and premium natural cosmetics.
When specialist expertise is required, we bring together trusted European partners in nutrition, science, regulation, claims and certifications.

values.text: Read the market before moving: categories, people, culture and the rules of the game.

values.title: Adapt
values.text: Keep your identity and make your story relevant where you land.

values.text: Find the partners and buyers that matter, and be visible where they are.

values.title: Activate
values.text: Turn insight into experiences, meetings and commercial momentum.

legal/cookie-policy.json.title: Cookie policy
legal/cookie-policy.json.intro: Which cookies and similar technologies this website uses, and how you can choose.

body.text: What cookies are

Cookies are small text files that websites store on your device when you visit them. They are used to remember your preferences, analyse how the site is used and improve your browsing experience. Similar technologies, such as your browser's local storage, work in the same way.
Cookies we use
This website does not use advertising or analytics cookies and does not track you. That is why it shows no cookie banner: there is nothing optional to accept or reject.

items: Fonts: the text fonts are loaded from Google Fonts. Your browser connects to Google's servers, which receive your IP address; Google Fonts does not set cookies.

body.text: How to manage cookies

You can configure your browser (Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, Microsoft Edge) to block or delete cookies at any time. Bear in mind that blocking technical cookies may affect how some websites work.
More information
If you have any questions about our cookie policy, write to {email}.

legal/privacy-policy.json.title: Privacy policy
legal/privacy-policy.json.intro: How we handle the personal data you share with us, in line with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).

body.text: 1. Data controller
2. Data we collect

This website does not ask you for personal data. When you complete the quiz, we receive the answers you choose (your situation, what you need, type of company, region, timing and budget range), which do not identify you.
If you book a call after the quiz, the booking tool (Calendly) also collects your name, your email and your answers to the quiz.
If you write to us by email, we receive your email address and whatever you tell us.
3. Purpose of the processing

The data you give us are used only to reply to your enquiry or request for information, to prepare a proposal and, if we work together, to manage the professional relationship. We do not use them for any other purpose without your express consent, we do not take automated decisions or build profiles, and we do not sell them to anyone.
4. Legal basis

The legal basis for processing your data is your consent when you book a call or write to us, and the steps taken at your request before entering into a contract (art. 6.1.a and 6.1.b GDPR). If we work together, the basis is the performance of the contract (art. 6.1.b) and compliance with our legal obligations (art. 6.1.c).
5. Data retention

We keep your data for the time needed to handle your enquiry and, afterwards, for the period legally required to meet possible liabilities. Once these purposes are fulfilled, the data are deleted. If we do not work together, we delete enquiries after 12 months.
6. Disclosure of data
We do not transfer your personal data to third parties, except under legal obligation.

To run this website we use providers that process data on our behalf: Raiola Networks (hosting and email, Spain) and Calendly (call bookings). The use of Calendly may involve transfers outside the EU, covered by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
7. Your rights
Under the GDPR and the LOPDGDD, you have the right to:

items: Request the erasure of your data
Object to the processing of your data
Request the portability of your data

body.text: To exercise these rights, write to {email}. You can withdraw your consent at any time. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
8. Security
We apply the technical and organisational measures needed to guarantee the security of your personal data and to prevent their destruction, loss, alteration, disclosure or unauthorised access.

services/create-the-right-connections.js.name: Create the right connections
services/create-the-right-connections.js.question: Identify the optimal route to market.
services/create-the-right-connections.js.hook: Connecting with the right distributor, importer, foodservice operator, retailer, or strategic partner can make the difference between having a product in a market and actually building a business there.
body: Origenal Story helps you identify the most relevant routes to market, commercial players and target accounts, and turn market intelligence into a practical business-development roadmap.

For companies entering or growing in Europe, attending or exhibiting at a trade fair can be one of the fastest ways to meet the right buyers, test your proposition and create commercial traction, if the key decision-makers are identified and contacted before, during and after the event.

items.title: Map the right routes to market
items.text: Understand the channels and commercial models that fit your product, category and objectives.

items.title: Identify the right players
items.text: Distributors, importers, buyers, foodservice operators, retailers, manufacturers and strategic partners.

items.title: Prioritise your targets
items.text: Qualify and segment potential accounts according to relevance, fit and commercial potential.

items.title: Understand who makes the decisions
items.text: Identify relevant decision-makers, influencers and commercial contacts.

items.title: Build the right connections
items.text: Support introductions and relationship-building through our European network.

items.title: Choose where to show up
items.text: Identify the trade fairs, conferences and sector events that are critical for your market, products or services and objectives.

items.title: Production is key
items.text: Work accurately on your event proposition, messaging, pitch and meeting materials for the European audience.

items.title: Networking
items.text: Support outreach, introductions, meeting generation, networking and on-site business conversations.

items.title: Turn conversations into next steps
items.text: Structure follow-up, qualify opportunities and help maintain the good contacts after the event.

steps.title: Find your route to market
steps.question: Channel & market access mapping
text: Before looking for a partner, we need to understand how your product can reach the market.
We analyse the relevant commercial routes and identify the channels that best fit your offer and objectives.
steps.best: Companies entering a new European market and deciding which commercial routes to explore.

steps.title: Identify the right players
steps.question: Distributor, buyer & partner mapping
text: Knowing the channel is only the beginning. The next step is identifying the companies that could actually move your product forward.
We map relevant distributors, importers, buyers, operators, manufacturers and potential strategic partners.
steps.best: Companies looking for the right commercial partners rather than a broad, unqualified contact list.

steps.title: Prioritise your targets
steps.question: Account & decision-maker intelligence
text: Not every potential account deserves the same level of attention.
We help you qualify and prioritise target companies and identify the people behind the buying and partnership decisions.
steps.best: Teams that need to focus their business-development efforts on the most relevant European accounts.

steps.title: Create the conversation and turn it into momentum
steps.question: How do we move from an introduction to a commercial opportunity?
text: The right target is only the beginning. We help structure conversations before and during the event and turn relevant contacts into qualified next steps afterwards.
Because a connection only becomes valuable when it moves somewhere.
steps.best: Brands looking to turn event participation into ongoing commercial relationships.

faq.q: How do I find the right distributor or importer in Europe?
faq.a: Before looking for a partner, we look at how your product can reach the market: retail, foodservice, distributors, importers, manufacturers or direct B2B. Then we map the companies that fit your offer, review their profile and portfolio fit, and prioritise the ones worth your time.

faq.q: Do you only deliver a list of contacts?
faq.a: No. A list is only the beginning. We help you qualify and prioritise target accounts, identify the people behind the buying and partnership decisions, and structure the conversations so that relevant contacts become qualified next steps.

faq.q: Is it worth exhibiting at a trade fair such as SIAL Paris, Anuga or Biofach?
faq.a: Attending or exhibiting at a trade fair can be one of the fastest ways to meet the right buyers, test your proposition and create commercial traction, as long as the key decision-makers are identified and contacted before, during and after the event. We help you choose where to show up, prepare your proposition and follow up afterwards.

faq.q: Which trade fairs and events do you work with?
faq.a: We follow the main food, ingredient, organic and natural cosmetics events in Europe, such as SIAL Paris, Anuga, Alimentaria, Biofach, Natexpo, Fruit Logistica and in-cosmetics Global, as well as sector conferences and summits.

faq.q: We already work with a distributor in Europe. Can you still help?
faq.a: Yes. If you are already active in Europe and want to scale, we review your current route to market, identify additional channels and target accounts, and help you prioritise where to grow next.

services/make-your-story-travel.json.name: Make your story travel
services/make-your-story-travel.json.question: Your story may be clear at home. Will it stay the same when you export it?
services/make-your-story-travel.json.hook: Entering a new country isn't just about translating your website or tweaking a few messages.
body: It is about understanding what makes your brand distinctive, what matters to your new audience, and how to express your value in a way that feels relevant locally.

Origenal Story helps you adapt your brand story, value proposition and commercial narrative to new markets: keeping your identity while making your story resonate with local buyers, partners and audiences.

steps.title: Tap into your Origenal Story
steps.question: Brand & value proposition
text: Before adapting your story to another market, you need to be clear about what makes you relevant and distinctive.
We identify your brand's strongest elements and translate them into a clear international value proposition.
steps.best: Companies preparing to introduce an existing brand or product into a new market.

steps.title: Chameleonise your story
steps.question: Brand storytelling & international market adaptation
text: Keep your identity. Your story doesn't need to become something else to work in a new market. It needs to become relevant.
We adapt your narrative to local culture, language, category codes and commercial realities, without losing the distinctive identity that makes your brand yours.
steps.best: Brands entering France, Spain or other European markets that need their story to resonate locally.

steps.title: Define your own commercial story
steps.question: B2B storytelling & sales narrative
text: Your story needs to work beyond your website.
We turn your value proposition into a commercial narrative that distributors, buyers, partners and industry professionals can understand and use.
steps.best: Companies preparing to approach European buyers, distributors, partners or industry events.

steps.title: Your story is alive
steps.question: Content, visibility & market activation
text: A story only creates value when it enters the world.

We help translate your new narrative into the touchpoints where your market actually encounters your brand, from trade fairs and industry events to B2B2C communications, PR and international networking.
steps.best: Brands ready to turn international positioning into visibility, conversations and commercial opportunities.

faq.q: Isn't translating our website and brochures enough?
faq.a: Entering a new country isn't just about translating your website or tweaking a few messages. It is about understanding what makes your brand distinctive, what matters to your new audience, and how to express your value in a way that feels relevant locally.

faq.q: Will adapting our story change our brand identity?
faq.a: No. Your story doesn't need to become something else to work in a new market. It needs to become relevant. We adapt your narrative to local culture, language, category codes and commercial realities without losing the identity that makes your brand yours.

faq.q: What do you actually deliver?
faq.a: Depending on your needs: a B2B value proposition, an elevator pitch, your company story, product or ingredient narratives, sales arguments, and presentation and trade-fair messaging that distributors, buyers and partners can understand and use.

faq.q: Do you adapt product claims and messages for European markets?
faq.a: Yes. We adapt messages and claims to local language, buyer expectations and category codes. When a claim needs regulatory or scientific validation, we work with trusted European specialist partners.

faq.q: In which languages do you work?
faq.a: English, Spanish, Portuguese and French.

services/read-the-market.json.name: Read the market
services/read-the-market.json.question: Where can your product create value in Europe?
services/read-the-market.json.hook: Your product is successful in your home market, and you're ready to grow internationally. Remember your product is only the starting point.
body: To grow successfully across borders, you need to understand the world around you: where it can create value, which markets and channels to explore, who to connect with, and what expertise you need to move forward.
We help you explore the opportunity step by step: from understanding the market and identifying gaps to checking requirements, finding the right channel and adapting your story for your new market.

When deeper specialist expertise is required, we bring together trusted European partners in nutrition, science, regulation, claims and certifications, ensuring the right expertise is connected to your expansion project.
support: Nutrition, scientific and claims expertise through specialist partners

steps.title: Explore the market
steps.question: What is happening, and where should you look?
text: We start by looking at the markets and categories relevant to your product or ingredient.
We look at what is changing, what people value, how the category is evolving and where demand is developing.
steps.expect: Market and category intelligence, relevant market comparison and an initial view of where your product could fit.
steps.best: Companies considering European expansion and needing to understand where to start.

steps.title: Identify the gaps & opportunities
steps.question: Where could your product create value?
text: Understanding a market is only the beginning. We look for the spaces where your offer can genuinely bring something different or solve an existing need.
We compare markets, categories and existing offers to identify where your product or ingredient could have the strongest potential.
steps.expect: Opportunity mapping, competitive benchmarking, market prioritisation and recommendations on where your offer could create the strongest value.
steps.best: Companies that need to decide which markets, categories or opportunities deserve their attention and investment.

steps.title: Understand your new universe
steps.question: Who and what will shape your opportunity?
text: Every market has its own ecosystem. Understanding it means looking beyond the product to the people, culture, behaviours, category codes and commercial environment around it.
We help you understand how your product may be perceived, used and valued, and who or what can influence its success.
steps.expect: Consumer and cultural insights, competitive context, market ecosystem mapping and a clearer picture of the people and dynamics surrounding your opportunity.
steps.best: Companies entering a market where they need to understand the new universe their product is entering, not simply the market statistics.

steps.title: Check claims and verifications
steps.question: What do you need to validate before you move forward?
text: A product that works in one market may face different expectations or requirements in another.
This can include reviewing the regulatory and certification landscape and identifying areas that need technical or scientific validation before market entry.
steps.expect: Regulatory and certification landscape, identification of relevant claims or technical questions, and access to specialist European expertise where required.
steps.best: Companies that need to make sure their product, claims and technical information are ready for the target market.

steps.title: Identify your channel & adapt your story
steps.question: How will your product reach the market, and how should you present it?
text: The right opportunity also depends on how you reach the market and how you make your offer relevant.

At the same time, we look at how your story, information and positioning may need to adapt to the new context: from brand positioning and storytelling to nutritional information, claims, cosmetics insights or other category-specific expectations, depending on your offer.
steps.expect: Route-to-market recommendations, channel priorities, initial commercial direction, and recommendations for adapting your brand story, product information and market-facing communication.
steps.best: Companies that know they want to enter a market and need to understand how to reach it and how to present themselves once they get there.

faq.q: How do I know if my product is ready for the European market?
faq.a: That is the first question this service answers. A product that works in one market may face different expectations or requirements in another. We compare markets, categories and existing offers to see where your product or ingredient has the strongest potential, and what you need to validate before moving forward.

faq.q: What does a European market opportunity study include?
faq.a: We look at market dynamics, category trends, market size and maturity, consumer expectations, the competitive landscape and the regulatory and certification landscape. We close with a market-entry assessment and go-to-market recommendations you can act on.

faq.q: Do you cover regulation, claims and certifications?
faq.a: We review the regulatory and certification landscape and identify what needs technical or scientific validation before market entry. When deeper specialist expertise is required, we bring in trusted European partners in nutrition, science, regulation, claims and certifications.

faq.q: Which products and sectors do you work with?
faq.a: Food and ingredients, gourmet and food service, well-being and cosmetics, and lifestyle and premium brands. We work with producers and brands from the Global South, especially Brazil and Latin America, that want to grow in Europe, and with European companies opening new markets.

faq.q: Which European markets do you cover?
faq.a: We are based in Barcelona and work across Europe. We have worked with clients in Spain, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany, Italy, Portugal, Switzerland, Denmark and the United Kingdom.

faq.q: How do we start?
faq.a: With a short conversation. Answer the three questions of our quiz and book a 1:1 call with Claudia Vasquez, founder of Origenal Story, to agree on the right starting point for your project.

services/understand-what-matters.json.name: Understand what matters
services/understand-what-matters.json.question: Activate what resonates.
services/understand-what-matters.json.hook: Entering a new market is not only about understanding the category or finding the right commercial partners.
body: It is about understanding the people behind the market: what they value, how they behave, what influences their choices and how those expectations are evolving.
Origenal Story helps you turn consumer and market insight into relevant opportunities, propositions and activations: connecting what people want with how your brand can engage with them locally.

items.title: Understand your consumers
items.text: Identify needs, behaviours, motivations, expectations and consumption occasions.

items.title: Decode local market dynamics
items.text: Understand how culture, lifestyle and category codes influence consumer choices.

items.title: Identify opportunities
items.text: Translate consumer and market signals into relevant product, proposition and activation opportunities.

items.title: Test & learn
items.text: Gather market feedback and refine your proposition before scaling.

items.title: Activate the market
items.text: Bring your proposition to life through experiences, events, partnerships, content and B2B2C initiatives.

steps.title: Understand your consumer
steps.question: Consumer & usage insight
text: Before activating a market, we need to understand the people you want to reach.
We explore the behaviours, needs, motivations and expectations that influence how consumers discover, evaluate, choose and use products.
steps.best: Companies entering a new market or looking to understand new consumer segments.

steps.title: Decode your market
steps.question: Consumer, culture & category insight
text: Consumer behaviour does not exist in isolation. Culture, lifestyle and category codes shape what feels relevant, desirable and credible.
We connect consumer insight with the local market context to identify emerging needs, behaviours and areas of opportunity.
steps.best: Brands that need to understand how local consumers think, choose and interact with their category.

steps.title: Translate insight into opportunity
steps.question: Consumer proposition & activation development
text: Insight only creates value when it informs decisions.
We translate consumer and market understanding into relevant propositions, concepts, messages and experiences that can be developed and tested.
steps.best: Companies looking to transform consumer insight into tangible market opportunities.

steps.title: Activate, test & learn
steps.question: Market activation & consumer engagement
text: The market is the ultimate test.
We help bring your proposition to life through relevant consumer and professional touchpoints, gathering feedback and learning from real interactions.
steps.best: Brands ready to test, activate and refine their proposition before broader market development.

faq.q: What is the difference between market intelligence and consumer insight?
faq.a: Market intelligence tells you where the opportunity is. Consumer insight tells you why people would choose you: their needs, behaviours, motivations, expectations and consumption occasions. You need both to enter a new market with a proposition that resonates.

faq.q: Why can't I use the same proposition that works in my home market?
faq.a: Because consumer behaviour does not exist in isolation. Culture, lifestyle and category codes shape what feels relevant, desirable and credible in each country. What is an everyday product at home can be a discovery, a premium treat or a functional product somewhere else.

faq.q: What do I get at the end of this work?
faq.a: Consumer and market understanding translated into something you can use: consumer propositions, concept ideas, usage occasions, messages and experiences that can be developed and tested in your target market.

faq.q: Can you test my product with real consumers before a launch?
faq.a: Yes. We help bring your proposition to life through tastings, events, partnerships, pop-ups and other consumer and professional touchpoints, gathering feedback and learning from real interactions.

faq.q: Is this only for consumer brands, or also for ingredient and B2B companies?
faq.a: For both. If you sell an ingredient or a B2B product, understanding the final consumer helps you make a stronger case to manufacturers, distributors and buyers. That is what we mean by B2B2C.
